says: In next/, the first start waits on its started latch with no bound, so a first start whose start event never folds hangs forever instead of failing.
proof: With dev.ts's isPid check disabled, L13 in dev.laws.integration.test.ts timed out at 60019 ms: DevLife refuses the fold, the driver returns without resolving started, and Deferred.await(started) at dev.ts:473 has no timeout, while the listener wait just above has START_BOUND.
cost: A start that Alchemy never reports, or one the life state refuses, hangs the app's start with no error.
